name: Learner Documents Backend/API Contract

contracts.title: Learner documents list
contracts.description: Returns documents visible to the current learner account.
contracts.access_rule: Only documents linked to the current learner context may be returned.

contracts.title: Learner document download/open
contracts.description: Returns a safe file response or redirect for a learner-owned document.
contracts.access_rule: The document must belong to the current learner context before file delivery.

contracts.title: Public document verification
contracts.description: Verifies a document by public number or verification code and returns only safe public fields.

query.value: required document number or verification code

contracts.access_rule: No private learner data or private storage paths may be returned.

access_control_requirements: Learner list endpoint must filter by current learner context.
Learner download endpoint must validate document ownership before file delivery.
Admin and organization document endpoints must remain separate from learner endpoints.
Public verification endpoint must return only public-safe fields.
Private storage paths must never be exposed in public responses.

migration_decision.rule: Stage 80.4 may add a migration only if the current schema cannot represent required contract fields safely.

recommendation.recommended_name: Learner Documents Backend/API Runtime Contract Implementation
